title: Sehrgar
text: Yangi qahramon — Sehrgar. 5 yurak, Ritsardan biroz tezroq yuradi. Space — qarab turgan tomonga sehrli shar otadi, dushmanni uzoqdan uradi va o'q hamda olov sharlarini ham yo'q qiladi. Space'ni bosib tursa — atrofga 2x zararli sehrli halqa. Shift — dash o'rniga qisqa teleport. Masofani saqlab jang qilishni yoqtiradiganlar uchun.

steps.eval: const p = g.player; p.fx = 1; p.fy = 0; p.cooldown = 0; g.bolts = [{ x: p.x + 30, y: p.y - 2, vx: 170, vy: 0 }, { x: p.x + 70, y: p.y - 2, vx: 170, vy: 0 }]; p.anim.set('attack', true); p.anim.frame = 1;
const p = g.player; p.spinTimer = 0.12; p.spinCooldown = 3; p.anim.set('attack', true); g.update(0.016); g.update = () => {};
const p = g.player; p.fx = 1; p.fy = 0; g.input.pressDash(); for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) g.update(0.016); g.update = () => {};

const all = new Map(); for (let k = 0; k < 60 && all.size < 9; k++) { g.stage = 'fight'; g.enemies = []; g.update(0.016); for (const u of g.choices) all.set(u.id, u); } g.choices = ['reach', 'blade', 'dash2'].map((id) => all.get(id)).filter(Boolean); g.choiceIndex = 0; g.upgradeLock = 0;
